name: Levi McPherson
role: Founder, The Beast Syndicate; CEO, ArguX AI and Switch Point Strategies
bio:
Levi McPherson is the Founder of The Beast Syndicate™ and CEO of ArguX AI and Switch Point Strategies. With more than 30 years of experience building and transforming companies, Levi has helped organizations achieve over $100 million in documented growth by aligning people, process, and performance systems.

He specializes in integrating AI technology with proven quality disciplines, helping teams evolve from static documentation to living systems of excellence that adapt and improve in real time. His frameworks have been applied across manufacturing, healthcare, and professional services to make operational excellence measurable, repeatable, and scalable.

history.title: The Next Evolution of Quality: Practical AI Tools That Improve Operations
